comment:
The sync mode, the wavetable bank, the shaper type and the enhancer type are also chosen from displays on the panel rather than from the right-click menu; only the bank, shaper and enhancer choices are parameters, so only those three can be clicked for help. Patching SKEW changes what its knob does: Terrorform.cpp:334 drops the knob's own contribution to zero the moment a cable is present and Terrorform.cpp:335 turns it into the attenuverter for the jack, so with a cable in and the knob at zero the skew is fixed at zero.
The two LPG TRIG jacks are stepped in the LPG's ordinary mode, where anything above 0V counts as a strike (Terrorform.cpp:495), and continuous in its velocity-sensitive mode, where a tenth of the voltage is the strike level. No step is written for them because it is not fixed.
